brief.name: Fiber and optic profile pair
brief.purpose: Unicorn and Hydra profile cards with visibly different keyed geometry and real UI labels
brief.learningIntent: O05 / T07; propagation modes are not guaranteed parallel data channels
brief.plannedMethod: Actual OpenAI base imagery with preserved original output; all exact labels/values in semantic UI, with manual diagrams/edits truthfully recorded

binding.alt: The Unicorn and three-headed Hydra occupy separate profile cards with a triangular key and a rectangular key.
binding.caption: Use the supplied single-mode or multimode profile card and compare every required field. The fictional keys distinguish the cards. Matching the shape alone cannot establish compatibility, and propagation modes do not promise independent data channels.

conversion: Scale the full uncropped frame with Lanczos and encode RGB WebP at quality 88, method 6. No retouching or labels in the derivative.
